name: Awareness of the outside and interaction with it
vision_statement: The AI knows what is outside the system and can interact with it: it brings in knowledge a reader can check and uses the right tool for each kind of need.
opportunities: Tool categories as solutions, with integrations as their implementations, and personal data locations resolved as a setup fact, go beyond bringing in a web search. A category can gain a better integration without any product rewriting its code.
solution_coherence: World is how the system learns what is outside it and acts on it. Science looks up what the research literature says and returns observations a reader can cite. Tools groups what the AI can use by category and reaches the web through Web Search and the places a person keeps personal data through Personal Data Locations.
